title: Scan Group Schema
description: JSON Schema for a single scan group definition.

name.description: Unique name for the scan group.

path.description: Path to the directory to scan.

indexFile.description: Path to the output index file.

description.description: Optional description of the scan group.

includePatterns.description: Array of glob patterns to include.

excludePatterns.description: Array of glob patterns to exclude.
